svg.title: Nyx — Computer Engineering graduate and MSc Cybersecurity student
svg.desc: A terminal card reading: I am a Computer Engineering graduate and MSc Cybersecurity student. I’m driven by curiosity about why security works the way it does, how systems fail, and how we can build a better, more secure future. Security stack: Splunk SIEM, Suricata, Wazuh, Burp Suite, Nmap, Nuclei, Wireshark, Metasploit, ClamAV. Identity: OIDC/SSO, TOTP MFA, RBAC. Frameworks: MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP LLM 2026, LLM red-teaming, GDPR/CCPA, NIST 800-53/61, ISO 27001. Engineering: Python, TypeScript, C++, Django, FastAPI, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS/Azure/GCP. Currently building Axiom, Oversight, and COMPASS-RT.
